text:
maya-chen: Hey team — first day! quick Qs: who should I ping for HubSpot seat, Gong access, and the call tool? blocked on a couple of things.

 tom-cs-lead: welcome aboard! ping @jess-ops for HubSpot and Aircall seats, @ryan-salesops for Gong. CS playbook lives in Notion under Customer Success › Playbooks › New Hire Playbook — I'll add you.

 jess-ops: hey @maya-chen, what email did you sign up with? I can provision HubSpot now. Also we keep sandbox creds in 1Password under "cs-sandbox".

 maya-chen: maya.chen@redwood.ai — thanks! I clicked the Notion link but I don't have access.

 tom-cs-lead: fixed your Notion perms. path: Notion › Customer Success › Playbooks › New Hire Playbook. you should have view + comment.

 emily-onboarding: I'll DM you the week-1 training schedule and pairings. FYI we use Aircall for CS (not Dialpad) — seats are provisioned by @jess-ops.

 ryan-salesops: I can request your Gong seat today. once you have it, enable the browser extension and join the 'CS - Incoming' workspace. we also turn on auto-tagging for initial training.

 infra-bot: Access ticket created: TICKET-4821 — assigned to jess-ops. ETA ~3 hours.

 jess-ops: @maya-chen HubSpot seat created (role: "CS Agent"). Login: https://redwood.hubspot.com/login. If you hit an MFA prompt, check 1Password entry "redwood-mfa".

 maya-chen: logged into HubSpot, thanks. I can't see call recordings in Gong yet though.

 ryan-salesops: requested your Gong license — you'll get an invite. If recordings are missing after that, confirm your Aircall number is linked (Aircall -> Integrations -> Gong). sometimes forwarding is off.

 emily-onboarding: note on retention: call recordings are retained 90 days by default. for training exports longer than that, ping me and I can export clips.

 tom-cs-lead: quick first-week checklist for CS hires:
1) HubSpot account + sample contacts imported
2) Aircall set up + test call
3) Gong access + watch 5 onboarding clips
4) Finish "CS fundamentals" module in LMS
5) Shadow 3 live calls with feedback notes
I'll drop this checklist into Notion as a checklist for you.

 maya-chen: sweet. one more — where do I find product one-pagers and playbook collateral? the Notion page references a broken link.

 jess-ops: collateral is stored in Google Drive: Drive › Sales & CS › Collateral › Feature One-Pagers. I'll also upload a copy to the Notion playbook for easier access.

 emily-onboarding: uploading now. also, if you want to poke at Aircall from a dev sandbox, here's a small test snippet (don't run on prod):

emily-onboarding: ```
# test outbound from sandbox
AIRCALL_TOKEN=redacted aircall call --to=+14075551234 --from=+14075550000 --play='test message'
```

 maya-chen: haha not running that on day one but good to know :laughing: 

 ryan-salesops: pro tip — in Gong search for tag:"onboarding" to find ~20 short training clips labeled for new hires. super useful for listening practice.

 tom-cs-lead: welcome again @maya-chen. I'll schedule your first shadow sessions and drop them into your calendar. :tada:

 maya-chen: thanks everyone! I'll follow up here if any of the access items stall.
